name: helios-connect
description: Use shared HELIOS task instructions and existing C# MCP tools from a trusted checkout in a Codex workspace.

interface.shortDescription: One HELIOS tool surface for your coding workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the existing HELIOS stdio MCP server using an explicitly selected trusted checkout. Reuses AIHub, Fabric planning and durable handoffs; carries no credentials and performs no automatic cloud activation.
defaultPrompt: Check HELIOS readiness and show the next connection step.
Show the HELIOS Fabric plan and pending handoffs.
